statements.text: Thrilled to welcome @Meta to #LA05! This groundbreaking $10 billion investment and new AI data center will shape the future of Richland Parish and our entire state for generations to come. https://t.co/lWrqwK2Lqj

With projects like Meta’s new AI data center on the way, the sky’s the limit for Louisiana’s economy.

Kudos to @LAGovJeffLandry and President Trump for steering our state and nation in the right direction! https://t.co/Bae7qViIrV
Louisiana’s own Richland Parish is destined to be a LEADER in AI development. Thank you President Trump for highlighting our progress! https://t.co/i5nHhwhSJk
statements.quoted: President Trump was given a graphic from Mark Zuckerberg showing the scale of Meta’s new AI factory in Louisiana: “We’re leading China now in AI.” https://t.co/m1fJ2IHnxn

statements.text: Our teachers got a much-needed shot in the arm with the Meta data centers.

statements.text: Thank you President Trump for releasing a plan for the United States to lead the world in Artificial Intelligence. We can unleash AI innovation and create jobs while protecting American families and our children. https://t.co/BXaJsI68Nr

statements.text: Government has a responsibility to protect Americans and put common-sense guardrails in place without overregulating this technology or allowing China to win the global AI race.

When it comes to artificial intelligence, Julia believes we must protect Americans, safeguard our national security, and ensure the United States remains the global leader in technological innovation. [...] She supports a thoughtful approach that addresses legitimate risks without imposing unnecessary regulations that put American businesses and workers at a disadvantage.
statements.venue: Letlow campaign statement reported by The Advocate/NOLA.com

statements.text: Julia believes Louisiana has an opportunity to lead in the development of new technologies that bring investment, create good-paying jobs, and strengthen our economy. [...] At the same time, that growth must be done responsibly, with transparency, community input, and protections to ensure Louisiana families and small businesses aren't left footing the bill for new infrastructure.
